characters.name: Gjertrud
characters.description: Gjertrud is a middle-aged woman with a sturdy build. She is often seen in her kitchen, characterized by a baking area and hearth, wearing a distinct red hat on her head, indicative of her role and personality. Her expression often reflects a mix of determination and frustration, particularly as she interacts with the expanding dough. She wears a simple, practical dress typical of a traditional baker, often dusted with flour. Her facial features show signs of weariness from a life of work, with keen eyes and a strong jawline.

characters.name: vor Herre
characters.description: Vor Herre is depicted as a tall, serene figure with an air of divine authority and kindness. He wears simple yet elegantly flowing robes that suggest his celestial nature. His facial features are gentle and compassionate, with deep, wise eyes and a thoughtful demeanor. He appears humble yet commanding, as he makes a request during their journey.

characters.name: St. Peder
characters.description: St. Peder is portrayed as a slightly shorter and more robust figure compared to Vor Herre. He has an approachable and kind demeanor, dressed in modest, earth-toned clothing that signifies his role as a follower. His face is rugged but warm, with a beard and a friendly expression.

characters.name: Gjertrudsfuglen
characters.description: Gjertrudsfuglen is a bird with striking features that includes a vivid red crest reminiscent of Gjertrud's hat, set against a body that is entirely black, suggesting soot from the chimney. The bird is depicted in motion, flying upward, and is known for its persistent pecking at trees and a posture that reflects its eternal thirst and restlessness. It is surrounded by elements of the natural environment, such as trees and occasional raindrops.
